title: Taiwanese Overseas Students Association at Boston University
content_html:
The Taiwanese Overseas Students Association at Boston University (TOSA, 波士頓大學台灣同學會) is a student organization focused on connecting Taiwanese international students with one another and with the broader BU campus community. TOSA is listed in BU’s official Terrier Central club directory and also appeared in BU’s 2018 club directory PDF alongside the Taiwanese American Student Association. The organization maintains an Instagram account (@tosa_bu) with over 1,300 followers and 540 posts, as well as a Facebook page at facebook.com/TOSAatBU.

TOSA’s programming has included social events such as Speed Friending and a recurring ‘Moonlight Month’ event series, as documented on its Facebook page. The organization was also recognized through BU’s official Giving Day fundraising platform (give.bu.edu), indicating institutional registration. TOSA’s Chinese name (波士頓大學台灣同學會) is shared with some other BUTSA-branded presences at BU, but TOSA operates as a distinct registered organization on Terrier Central.

Sources: bu.campuslabs.com/engage/organization/taiwanese-overseas-students-association (Terrier Central, BU official club directory); instagram.com/tosa_bu; facebook.com/TOSAatBU; give.bu.edu (BU Giving Day); www.bu.edu/cas/files/2018/08/BU-Clubs-Organizations-2.pdf (BU CAS Club Directory, 2018).
